result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. The bug was in the merge condition on line 54 of `src/lib.rs`. It was using `<` instead of `<=`, which prevented touching spans (where one ends exactly where the other begins) from being merged.

Changed:
```rust
Some(last) if s.start < last.end => last.end = last.end.max(s.end),
```

To:
```rust
Some(last) if s.start <= last.end => last.end = last.end.max(s.end),
```

This now correctly merges spans that touch at their boundaries, like [1, 4) and [4, 6) → [1, 6).
